abilities.name: Void Command
abilities.text: Once per round, after you clear a sector or complete a Contract, record 1 Command Note.

abilities.name: Ashwake Step
abilities.text: At the start of your turn in a clear sector, record 1 Command Note.

abilities.name: Signal Relay
abilities.text: When another operative in your sector rolls a battle or test, you may spend 1 Command Note to give them +1.

abilities.name: Marshal's Presence
abilities.text: Once per round, after a successful objective push, reduce scenario pressure by 1 if it is above 0. Weakness: Command Notes cannot be spent on your own Signal tests.
